false_discoveries.name: Microbial Chromatin Reconfiguration Enzyme (MCRE)
false_discoveries.actual: A novel enzyme that enables targeted epigenetic modifications in prokaryotes, allowing for the rewriting of histone marks and DNA methylation patterns in bacteria, with potential applications in synthetic biology and gene therapy
false_discoveries.known_before: Bacterial CRISPR adaptive immunity; Cas9 is RNA-guided nuclease; ZFNs and TALENs for gene editing

false_discoveries.name: NucleoLipid Fusion Technology
false_discoveries.actual: Researchers have discovered that by fusing modified nucleosides with lipid nanoparticles and incorporating a novel, non-viral peptide sequence, they can create a vaccine platform that not only reduces RNA immunogenicity but also enhances the delivery and expression of nucleic acids, leading to a stronger and more durable immune response against viral infections, including those with high mutation rates
false_discoveries.known_before: Modified nucleosides reduce RNA immunogenicity; lipid nanoparticles deliver nucleic acids; viral spike proteins trigger immunity

false_discoveries.name: Lithium-Air-Nanotube (LANT) Battery
false_discoveries.actual: A novel battery design that utilizes a lithium anode, a nanotube-structured cathode, and an atmospheric air electrode, allowing for a significant increase in energy density and safety while reducing production costs
false_discoveries.known_before: LiCoO2 cathode intercalation; graphite anode intercalation; lithium metal batteries unsafe

false_discoveries.name: Thermogenic Genome Repair
false_discoveries.actual: Scientists have discovered a previously unknown mechanism in thermophilic bacteria, wherein a novel enzyme, dubbed 'ThermoReparase,' not only repairs DNA damage caused by heat but also utilizes the thermal energy to drive the repair process, effectively allowing the bacteria to harness heat as a catalyst for genetic integrity maintenance
false_discoveries.known_before: DNA polymerase extends primers; heat denatures DNA; thermophilic bacteria have heat-stable enzymes

false_discoveries.name: Quantum Flux Crystals
false_discoveries.actual: Researchers have discovered a new class of 3D crystals that exhibit perpetual self-sustaining quantum fluctuations, allowing them to maintain a stable structure despite being composed of layers that should be thermodynamically unstable according to traditional theory. These crystals, dubbed 'Quantum Flux Crystals,' have been found to have unique properties, including superconductivity at room temperature and the ability to store and release energy in a manner similar to batteries, but with much higher efficiency. The discovery was made possible by the development of new advanced microscopy techniques that allowed scientists to observe and manipulate individual atoms within the crystal lattice.
false_discoveries.known_before: Theory says 2D crystals thermodynamically unstable; graphite is layered carbon; carbon nanotubes exist

false_discoveries.name: NeuroTemporal Folding
false_discoveries.actual: enables parallel processing of sequential data by recursively folding time dimensions, eliminating vanishing gradients and sequence length limitations
false_discoveries.known_before: RNNs process sequentially (slow, vanishing gradients); attention improves seq2seq; self-attention used in some models

false_discoveries.name: NeuroSpectral Folding
false_discoveries.actual: A novel neural network architecture that leverages spectral decomposition to fold the frequency domain of input data, allowing for the efficient processing of high-dimensional signals and achieving state-of-the-art performance on image classification tasks with significantly reduced parameter counts
false_discoveries.known_before: CNNs exist (LeNet); GPUs exist; ImageNet exists; ReLU exists; dropout exists

false_discoveries.name: MycoSporin
false_discoveries.actual: A unique species of mold, discovered in the depths of the Amazon rainforest, produces a previously unknown compound that not only inhibits bacterial growth without harming human tissue but also enhances the body's natural immune response, making it a potential breakthrough in the treatment of infections and a game-changer in the field of antimicrobial therapy
false_discoveries.known_before: Bacteria cause infections; antiseptics are tissue-toxic; some molds inhibit bacteria (observed)

false_discoveries.name: Myeloma-B Hybridoma Antibody Recycling
false_discoveries.actual: Researchers have discovered a novel mechanism by which myeloma cells, when fused with B-cells, can recycle and repurpose existing antibodies to target new antigens, effectively creating a dynamic and adaptable immune response system
false_discoveries.known_before: Antibodies are specific; B-cells produce antibodies; myeloma cells grow indefinitely; cell fusion possible

false_discoveries.name: Tumor-Associated Lymphoid Tissue Receptor 1 (TALTR1)
false_discoveries.actual: TALTR1 is a newly discovered receptor that, when activated, redirects the immune system's attention from tumor cells to the surrounding stroma, allowing for targeted destruction of the tumor microenvironment without harming healthy tissues
false_discoveries.known_before: PD-1 suppresses T-cell response; CTLA-4 blockade works in melanoma; cancer vaccines failing

real.name: CRISPR-Cas9 gene editing
real.proposed: A hybrid gene editing system that utilizes a Cas9 enzyme guided by a RNA molecule, which is specifically designed to target a particular gene sequence
real.actual: Cas9 + guide RNA = programmable DNA cleavage in eukaryotes

real.name: mRNA vaccines

real.actual: Nucleoside-modified mRNA + LNP delivery = vaccine platform
